notes: The class timer in Present takes minutes and seconds: type them in, or pick 0:30 and the other quick times. The menu remembers the last time you typed.
While it runs, the timer's menu adds or takes away 10 seconds or a minute, pauses, and restarts from the time you set. + and − add or take away a minute without opening the menu.
Tick Show it big to put the countdown in the middle of the screen, large enough for the back of the room.
